subject: general
question: The mouse that uses photodiodes and light-emitting diode (LED) technology is called a/an _______ mouse.
solution:
A mouse is a small hardware input device used by hand. It controls the movement of the cursor on the computer screen and allows users to move and select folders, text, files, and icons on a computer. It is an object, which needs to be put on a hard flat surface to use.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Optical Mouse**

__
 
• An optical mouse also has a light emitter and light detector but it uses LED as the light emitter.
 
• It generally has a lower DPI than a laser mouse and users might find difficulty in using the device on black or shiny surfaces.

 [IMAGE: https://techexplainer.files.wordpress.com/2012/03/optical-mouse.jpg?w=300&h=238] 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Type of mouse**
 **Description**
 
 

 **Mechanical Mouse**
 
 
It is also called the ball mouse, a mechanical mouse has a rubber or metal ball on its underside.

 [IMAGE: https://techexplainer.files.wordpress.com/2012/03/mechanical-mouse.jpg?w=300&h=238] 
 
 
 

 **Optomechanical or Optical-mechanical Mouse**
 
 
An Optomechanical or optical-mechanical mouse is the same as the mechanical mouse except that the sensors used in it are optical and not mechanical.

 
 
 

 **Laser mouse**
 
 
A laser mouse is the new generation mouse with two necessary components – a light emitter and a light detector.

 
 [IMAGE: https://techexplainer.files.wordpress.com/2012/03/laser-mouse.jpg?w=300&h=238] 

 
 
 

***Based on the above definitions the mouse that uses photodiodes and light-emitting diode (LED) technology are called an optical mouse.***
